profile.title: Entry-Level Full-Stack Engineer (Backend Focus)
profile.tagline: CS Engineering student specializing in Node.js REST APIs, microservices, Redis caching, and React.js frontend interfaces.
profile.subheading: B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering @ Assam Engineering College (CGPA: 8.18)
profile.bio: I am a Computer Science Engineering student at Assam Engineering College (CGPA: 8.18) passionate about full-stack web development with a strong focus on backend systems. I enjoy building applications with Node.js, Express, databases, microservices, and React.js.

projects.title: Resume Analyzer (AI-Powered)
projects.description: An AI app that parses candidate resumes against target career goals to generate structured feedback reports. Built with a Node.js backend using Groq LLMs to produce reliable JSON outputs, resume scores, and actionable feedback.

projects.title: Scalable Web Backend with Rate Limiting & Caching
projects.description: A backend project built to practice handling peak web traffic. Features Redis caching for fast responses, IP-based sliding window rate limiting, and Redis BullMQ for background workers like non-blocking Cloudinary image deletion.

projects.title: Node.js Microservices Architecture with Kafka
projects.description: A simple microservices system built to learn how distributed systems work. Includes an API Gateway routing requests to an Auth Service, Task Service, and Media Service, using Apache Kafka for pub/sub messaging and PostgreSQL for storage.

experience.title: Industrial Intern
experience.description: Engineered a browser-based interactive treadmill game built with React.js and ESP32 hardware integration. Captured sensor data using TCRT5000 sensors and transmitted user activity via ESP32 Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) for real-time gameplay.

experience.title: Winter Intern
experience.description: Developed a Machine Learning-based mechanical failure prediction system using Random Forest for industrial maintenance. Built data preprocessing and feature engineering pipelines for analyzing sensor streams.

experience.title: Summer Intern
experience.description: Constructed a heart disease predictive model in Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn). Applied classification algorithms on clinical datasets to analyze key health risk factors.
